findings.text: The reproduction pointer names docs/figures/fleet-view-rendering/evidence-probe/log-cc-10000.create as the file carrying "There is no active session!", but that file is 0 bytes; the string is in docs/figures/fleet-view-rendering/probe/create-cc-10000.out (28 bytes), so a reader following the pointer finds nothing.

The zero-stall claim ("a delta of zero in every probe run") has no committed receipt: run5.sh counts the server log before and after each run but only echoes stall_log_delta to stdout (probe/run5.sh:45) and no run's stdout was kept, while the counted log is node-local on 98dci4-clu-2058 and dies with job 1277272; the claim is true (re-verified today: 33 stall lines, last at 22:30:48.186, all predating the probe runs) but lives nowhere in the record.

"They begin at 22:23:05, forty seconds after a second new tab was created" misstates the interval: the log shows tab 5 at 22:22:26.055 and tab 6 at 22:22:56.655, so the first stall (22:23:05.507) is 8.85 s after the second tab and 39.4 s after the first; the follow-up reading survives (both tabs precede every stall) but the stated interval does not.

item_verdicts.diff: Single commit 6bfe2da2 (docs(research): measure fleet-view render cost from a throwaway probe), 34 files, 1213 insertions, all documentation, figures, raw evidence and probe scripts; no executable path is changed and no runtime code imports or calls any of it.
item_verdicts.done_when: The measure is the research note plus `reckon audit-doc`; I re-ran the audit-doc gate verbatim (OK, exit 0), re-derived the §2 table from the committed evidence files (docs/figures/fleet-view-rendering/evidence-probe/log-*.timed), re-ran the capture counts on first-client-diffsize.bin, and re-verified on the fleet node that the socket dir lists three live sessions with no probe session and that the live log holds 33 stall lines, last at 22:30:48.186 — every verifiable clause matches.
item_verdicts.goal: The dispatched goal is to name the cause of the fleet zellij attach-time stalls, tab-bar flicker and duplicated lines from a throwaway reproduction (/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20260924T204304002260-fleet-view-stall-cause/prompt.txt); the landed note reports the symptoms were not reproduced and names no cause, delivering instead the measured render cost, a falsified resize-storm hypothesis and two reproduced harness defects (docs/research/fleet-view-rendering.html:20-41,104-127).
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, one commit named, the negative control plus its absence-claim positive control documented, followups f-fvr-001 and f-fvr-002 left open; `reckon crew check-manifest --run r-20260924T204304002260-fleet-view-stall-cause` returns {"findings": [], "ok": true}.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Of the five declared paths, two were deliberately not written and the reasons returned as data (manifest blockers field); every one of the 34 committed files sits under docs/figures/fleet-view-rendering/ or is docs/research/fleet-view-rendering.html, both inside the fence; nothing outside the fence was touched.

justifications.durability: No test fails if the note's claims or its raw evidence regress — audit-doc checks document shape and links, not claims — so a later edit contradicting the committed evidence files would go undetected; not lower because the raw evidence is committed beside the note and the negative control is a real, run one.
justifications.evidence: Every number in §2 matches the committed .timed evidence files, the 33-line positive control and the live socket listing reproduced independently by me on 98dci4-clu-2058, and the audit-doc gate re-ran clean; deductions for the probe-side zero-stall claim carrying no committed receipt (the before/after counter delta was echoed to stdout by probe/run5.sh:45 and captured in no file, and the log it counts is node-local and dies with job 1277272 — I re-verified the claim true, but the record alone cannot show it) and for each timing cell being a single sample with no repeat or spread.
justifications.fit: Follows the repo research-doc idiom (plan-doc headings, project-absolute figure src, followups carrying capability metadata, raw evidence committed in-tree) and the probe-safety rules in the plan; deduction for the shipped probe tree retaining five superseded iterations (probe2/3/4, run2..5, cfg variants) with only probe4.py and run5.sh canonical and nothing in the tree marking which is which, so a reader needs §5 to avoid the dead ones.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The headline the goal names — the cause — is not delivered; what is delivered is a negative result (no stall at either scrollback setting, control indistinguishable, resize-storm hypothesis falsified) plus two reproduced harness defects and a falsifiable next step, so the plan's own measure is met while a reader who wanted the cause gets a repro-change plan instead (docs/research/fleet-view-rendering.html:146-168).
justifications.scope_discipline: No file outside the declared paths; the two coordinator-owned landing artefacts were refused rather than written and the reasons returned as data, which is the contract-correct handling; superseded numbered probe iterations shipped beside the canonical scripts are in scope and are scored under fit rather than here.
